id: title:adamleithp:rebuild the posthog ai panel in quill

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a frontend-only AI chat panel and its associated UI components, including a dropdown menu for session selection, an empty state with Anthropic API configuration, and the panel registration in the Max tab. No backend, ingestion, or warehouse changes are supplied.
review.reason: This chunk represents a narrow, localized frontend implementation. It adds UI components and registration for a new AI chat panel, including dropdown selection, empty states, and tab association. While the backend and complete context panel behavior are not supplied, the observed changes are substantive enough to establish a tier. The tier is assigned based on the visible frontend,

observations.limitations: This chunk is a frontend-only implementation of a new AI chat panel and its associated UI. No backend, ingestion, or warehouse changes are supplied. No tier assignment is possible.

observations.behavior: Adds a new dropdown menu component for the AI chat title, including recent group and item selection, loading states, and unread indicators.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides a dropdown menu for selecting recent AI chat sessions and their items, including loading and unread states.

observations.behavior: Adds a new panel component that conditionally renders the AI chat or legacy side panel, including an empty state with an Anthropic API key configuration link.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides an empty state and configuration guidance for users who have not set up the Anthropic API key.

observations.behavior: Adds the TodayAiPanel component to the QUILL_TAB_PANELS mapping, associating the Max tab with the new AI panel.
observations.posthog_connection: Associates the Max tab with the new AI panel, enabling the AI chat to be displayed in the side panel.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the complete implementation of the referenced AI chat and context panel. P1.F5.H1 adds a new kea logic, P1.F6.H1 adds a comment and a selector dependency, but the actual AI chat implementation and the complete context panel behavior are not supplied. No score can be assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a new kea logic, todayAiChatLogic, with selectors, actions, and listeners for PostHog AI chat, including session read requests, full-screen carry, and PostHog event capture.
observations.code_quote: // Report and scout chats run on the task runner in either view, the same as the side panel's own header.
observations.posthog_connection: Connects PostHog AI chat to the layout, carrying context and reporting session reads; P1.F6.H1 adds a comment and selector dependency, but the complete AI chat and context panel implementation are not supplied, so the observed benefit cannot be established.
